fields.name: Edit_Can_Entryway_Receive_Pallets
fields.fieldText: Can your delivery location receive pallets at the ground level?
fields.helpText: A standard pallet size is 48” x 40”, 6 feet tall, and can hold up to 4,600 lbs. Measure your entryway to ensure that you are able to accept a pallet delivery. Some entryways have a removable center bar for pallets.

fields.name: Edit_Loading_Dock
fields.fieldText: Does your delivery location have a loading dock?
fields.helpText: A dock area should be flexible enough to accommodate any shipping vehicle. The most common dock height is 48” – 52”.

fields.name: inactivate_shipping_address_header
fields.fieldText:
Deactivate this Shipping Address?


If this shipping address is no longer associated with your organization, please select "Deactivate Shipping Address".

Once deactivated, the shipping address will no longer be visible or available for use.

screens.description: Show this to the customer when a new shipping address is being created.
screens.name: New_Shipping_Address
screens.label: New Shipping Address

fields.name: new_shipping_address_text
fields.fieldText:
Shipping address in use


This shipping address is already associated with one or more of your existing Orders.


What does this mean for you?

  • Any Orders that you have already submitted will not be changed.
  • Any open Orders will be updated after you save your changes. You will need to reconfirm the Delivery Details on those Sites before submitting your Order.

Do you need to change the actual address?

  • If you need to change the actual address, you will need to create a new Shipping Address. Please go to the "Shipping Address" tab to add a new address.
